_readme: Practices and matches. Times are local to the course. Keep past items — the app filters them out. While 'events' is empty the Schedule tab and the 'Next up' card both read 'Nothing scheduled yet.', which is true and is better than a fixture nobody is playing.
_lineup: A match can carry a 'lineup': playing order and tee times, shown on the event. Publishing it puts student names on a public page, so it is governed by the same privacy decision as the results cards — leave 'lineup' out entirely and the event renders without it. Initials or first names are a middle option.
